<div class="review-text">
Outer Wilds is one of the most fantastic atmospheric adventure games I've ever played. The closest possible comparison I could make is to Myst, but that doesn't do Outer Wilds justice at all. Easily a 10/10.<br>
<br>
It's a difficult game to discuss in detail without spoiling it, and I would recommend you go into it blind. But I certainly hope you can trust me. &lt;3
</div>
